roles-and-permissions.purpose: Let admins grant access safely with dependencies, auditability, templates, review paths, and reversible feedback.
useWhen: Users assign permissions, roles, or access templates.
Permission changes need review, audit, or dependency checks.
A matrix or table must explain who gets access and why.
doNotUseWithoutReview: Permission source, owner, or dependency model is unclear.
Changes can affect finance, compliance, identity, or security without approval.
The surface cannot show audit evidence or recovery.
foundations: Defines matrix density, role grouping, review panel placement, and audit spacing.
Owns role labels, permission copy, dependency warnings, and audit language.
Controls enabled, inherited, warning, and pending states without color-only meaning.
Enabled, disabled, inherited, pending, blocked, dirty, saved, and audit states are explicit.
Confirmation and policy hints layer above the matrix with Design System overlays.
Permission state, role scope, dependency warnings, and audit trail are text-backed.
slots: Role/permission grid using package Table for structure.
Review, save, cancel, or request approval.
variants: Permissions are grouped by role and capability.
Sensitive changes require confirmation or approval.
motion: Permission state updates immediately but save/review remains explicit.
Toast or audit update confirms the result.
accessibility: Permission labels identify role and capability.
Inherited or blocked states are text-backed.
Audit events are readable in order.
tests: Permission toggle marks the matrix dirty.
Save reveals feedback and audit evidence.
Keyboard users can reach controls and actions.

canDecide: Use Roles and Permissions for access policy processs.
Use Table plus atomic controls; do not package Permission Matrix as a component.
Require audit evidence for permission changes.
mustAsk: Role model, dependency policy, approval system, audit requirements, or tenant scope is unclear.
Changes affect finance, security, compliance, legal, or identity access.
rejectIf: Permission changes have no audit path.
Blocked or inherited states are color-only.
miel.handoff: Confirm roles, capabilities, dependencies, approval policy, audit requirements, tenant scope, and recovery behavior.
